title: Perfect color but really blurry
text: Perfect color but really blurry. These custom pictures are a fantastic idea. I received my order fast and the fabric quality is great. It’s helpful if we knew what pixel quality would work best instead of guessing. My image is extremely blurry and doesn’t look anything like the original picture, but If I knew what would have worked and fit, I would have picked a different image. The color quality is good though. I had a hard to match color and it actually printed. I’m happy for that. It’s being used as a backdrop so perfect sharpness is not a big deal. If you want a sharp image then more specific submission info would be helpful.
